# dsh-plugin-settings-float
DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns the settings dialog into a **draggable, edge-resizable floating w
indow**, so you can keep the chat visible (and usable) while changing settings.
The native settings surface is a centered modal with a full-screen scrim: it covers the conversation
and cannot be moved. This plugin keeps the same React tree but lifts the panel out of the modal — n
o scrim, a floating panel you can drag by its header and resize from any edge or corner.
> ⚠️ This is a **DOM-level enhancement** built against the current DSH settings shell. The upstream
bundle is never modified, and if a DSH upgrade changes the settings markup the plugin simply stops a
pplying (the settings page keeps working as the native modal). Treat it as a convenience layer, not
(the settings page keeps working as the native modal). Treat it as a convenience layer, not a fork.
## Features

- **Draggable** — grab the nav title or content header and move the window anywhere.
- **Eight resiz

e handles** — drag any edge (↑↓←→) or corner (⤡ ⤢); opposite edges stay anchored.
- **Chat stays ali
ve** — the dark scrim is removed and the overlay stops swallowing pointer events, so the conversatio

n is visible and clickable behind the window.
- **Remembers geometry** — position and size persist i

n `localStorage` per browser profile.
- **Reset shortcuts** — double-click a header to snap back to

the default spot; double-click a resize handle to restore the default size.
- **Configurable** — def
aults, minimum size, enable switch and optional click-outside-to-close are exposed as a DSH plugin c
mum size, enable switch and optional click-outside-to-close are exposed as a DSH plugin config card.

## Usage
| Action | Result |

| Drag nav title / content header | Move the window |
| Drag any edge or corner | Resize (min size a

pplies, viewport-clamped) |
| Double-click a header | Reset position to the default spot (right side

, vertically centered) |
| Double-click a resize handle | Reset size to the configured default |
| E
sc / ✕ | Close settings (unchanged) |
## Configuration
Open **Settings → Plugins → Settings Float** (the card is generated from the plugin schema), or set
the row config in the profile patch:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | `false` keeps the native centered modal |
| `defaultWidth` / `defaultHeight`

| `760` / `720` | Initial size, used until the user resizes once |
| `minWidth` / `minHeight` | `480

` / `320` | Smallest size the window can be dragged to |
| `closeOnOutsideClick` | `false` | Sends `
Escape` when the chat behind the window is clicked |
## Compatibility

- Verified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` (desktop and web profile share the same settings shell).
- The p
anel is found by `role="dialog"` + settings-only children, with the release's hashed class only as a

fast path — so a rename usually degrades gracefully instead of breaking.
- Requires a web-capable D
SH surface (`dsh.client` platform `web`).
## Privacy

- No network requests, no host-side changes, no telemetry.
- Only two `localStorage` keys are writte
n: `dsh.settings-float.pos.v1` and `dsh.settings-float.size.v1`.
